question_stem:
The rate of flow Q of a liquid along a narrow pipe of length L and radius r is given by
Q =(αr ^{4})/(L)
where α is a constant.
An experiment is carried out to determine the value of α. The data from the experiment are shown
in Table 1.1.
Table 1.1
quantity
value
percentage uncertainty
Q
2.72 × 10^{-8} m^{3} s^{-1}
± 3%
r
7.1 × 10^{-5} m
± 2%
L
2.5 × 10^{-2} m
± 4%

parts.question_text: Use information in Table 1.1 to show that the SI base unit of α is s^{-1}.
